nodes.label: Three-Layer Transcript Model
nodes.rationale: Each layer is kept independently so the pipeline is auditable and every automated change is reversible.

nodes.label: Layer 1 - Raw Transcript (immutable)
nodes.rationale: Keeping the exact whisper.cpp output plus provenance makes the raw layer immutable so correctness can be re-proven via content hash.

nodes.label: Layer 2 - Normalized Transcript (deterministic)
nodes.rationale: Normalization is non-generative and deterministic so the same raw input always yields byte-identical output without changing any word, name, number or fact.

nodes.label: Layer 3 - Context Repair (optional, auditable, reversible)
nodes.rationale: Context Repair is opt-in and guarded so the application stays fully functional with no provider configured and an LLM can never quietly invent facts or names.

nodes.label: Real-media finding: prompting vs Context Repair
nodes.rationale: On a real Egypt-lecture excerpt the Whisper --prompt did not correct 'Mark Lainer'->'Mark Lehner' or 'dolarite'->'dolerite' even when correct spellings were in the prompt; post-hoc Context Repair proposed exactly those corrections. The Whisper prompt is a weak decoder bias; review-based Context Repair is more effective for specific names and never applies a name change without user acceptance.

nodes.label: Input-aware Stage Caching (v1.1)
nodes.rationale: Stages cache by their inputs so changing any input re-runs only the affected stages; unchanged stages are marked Cached.

nodes.label: Studio Neobrutalist Redesign
nodes.rationale: Redesigned from 'Premium Glassmorphic Dark' (Catppuccin Mocha) to a refined neobrutalist 'Studio' style matching LecturePack Studio.dc.html mockup, with light and dark themes supported equally.

nodes.label: Studio Refined Neobrutalism design characteristics
nodes.rationale: Borders 1.5px, radius 6-13px, soft multilayer shadows, no glassmorphism, opaque backgrounds, card hover translateY(-2px).

nodes.label: Grounded cloze study fallbacks
nodes.rationale: Deterministic fallback replaced with grounded cloze from real transcript sentences (distractors = other key terms absent from that sentence) so no-AI mode still produces transcript-grounded material.

nodes.label: Lazy thumbnail cache (lpasset://thumb)
nodes.rationale: Non-blocking thumbnail generation prevents starving the main thread; WebP reduces payload ~192x vs full-res PNG.

nodes.label: Main slide preview scaling (previewCtl)
nodes.rationale: Fixed 74%/16:9 frame letterboxed 4:3 images to 19% area; fill-canvas with fit=min() + zoom/pan controls raised utilization to 92% width.
